bundle.shortDescription: A fast DataGrip-style database client built with Rust and Tauri.
bundle.longDescription: Prometeo DataGrip is a desktop database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite and Oracle: SQL editor, schema explorer, virtualized data grid, export, import, query history and DDL view.
